articleTitle: A kind of embedded control system according to the humanoid robot hand
publicationTitle: IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Systems and Signal Processing, 2003. Proceedings. 2003
abstract: In this paper, we put foreword a kind of embedded control system according to the humanoid robot hand based on AT89C2051, from bionics, and designed a kind of construction according to the humanoid robot hand. Then expatriated how to realize five independent adjustable signals of PWM based on a block of 3/spl times/5 cm controlling circuit using 89C2051. We have realized that the movement speed is adjustable, the least response time is T<0.012 ms, and the electromotor least movement scope is 1 degree. We can save 200 action data that have programmed in the controller or controlled by serial communication.

articleTitle: Augmented interaction: interacting with virtual object through a displacement/force input device
publicationTitle: IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Systems and Signal Processing, 2003. Proceedings. 2003
abstract: An input device was proposed for human-computer interaction (HCI) by adding motion/position information to object in virtual environment. It can be used as a teaching and programming device by human demonstration through acquiring the human hand haptic information and manipulate virtual object in computer. The design and use of the device was described. The human compliant motion and its perception model were discussed in details. In the end some possible applications of the motion/force input device was introduced.

articleTitle: Robust component synthesis vibration suppression command for flexible spacecrafts with on-off actuators
publicationTitle: IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Systems and Signal Processing, 2003. Proceedings. 2003
abstract: This paper presents a development of component synthesis vibration suppression (CSVS) method for maneuvering flexible spacecrafts. The proposed method eliminates unwanted flexible vibrations while achieving the desired rigid body attitude motion. The robustness to uncertainties of dynamic modeling parameters is analyzed. Unlike traditional input shaping in which a numerical optimization is utilized, design for CSVS commands is based on analytic methodology and is relative easy to implement. A case study is performed on a time-fuel optimal control strategy using constant amplitude reaction thrusters. Both simulation and experimental results validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Constructing for irregular region in fractal image compression
publicationTitle: IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Systems and Signal Processing, 2003. Proceedings. 2003
abstract: This paper purposes a novel algorithm for image partition using irregular region in fractal image compression, which greatly increases the compression ratios achieved over traditional block-based partition. Also, due to the large search space involved (transformations and match), similar extension algorithms which are described are used to construct the irregular region transformations, and results for similar extension algorithms are shown. The results show that the algorithm of irregular region achieves almost double the compression ratio of simple block-based system at a similar decompressed image quality.

articleTitle: Distributed military power station measure-control system by CAN-bus
publicationTitle: IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Systems and Signal Processing, 2003. Proceedings. 2003
abstract: First, an analysis of the status of the military power station (MPS) and its measure-control system (MCS) in the weapon system and modern war were presented. Then presentation of construction and principle of distributed MCS, types of the measured signal, characteristics of simulative load and its switch-control signal were discussed. Finally, a discussion of the main technical issues and solutions in this distributed MCS system were given.

articleTitle: A model water turbine rotary blade profile measuring robot
publicationTitle: IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Systems and Signal Processing, 2003. Proceedings. 2003
abstract: The water turbine's rotary blade has a spatial warping hood face, so the hydroelectric generation stations are always puzzled how to field measure this hood face. This paper puts forward a new method of rotary blade profile's field surveying by using measuring robots. It also makes the analysis of the measuring robots' working principle as well as advantages. The prototype of the measuring robot has been triturated, and reached the design and usage requirements by field measuring rotary blade profile.

articleTitle: A new control topology of information reliable spread
publicationTitle: IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Systems and Signal Processing, 2003. Proceedings. 2003
abstract: High reliable multicast service is a new information transfer service mode based on IP route. The implement of reliable multicast depends on the control topology structure. With the analysis of control topology structure of the current logical hypercube based reliable multicast protocol, this paper brings forward a new reliable multicast control topology structure-ComCube. The feature of the structure is analyzed such as scalability, fault tolerance, length of multicast route, nodes' load, stability and maintenance. The analysis shows that ComCube has good scalability, balanced nodes' load, stable structure and it can be established easily and maintained expediently.

articleTitle: The Arm/Hand integrated telerobotic system based on sensory information
publicationTitle: IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Systems and Signal Processing, 2003. Proceedings. 2003
abstract: This paper describes the Arm/Hand integrated telerobotic system and its multisensor integration and fusion. The characteristic of intelligent robotic system and the role of sensory data fusion in different abstract level are analyzed. A new flexible control structure is proposed to integrate different types of sensors. Neural network is used to obtain more abstract information from force and torque sensors, and knowledge based multisensor fusion method is developed to fuse the sensory information which is not only directly acquired from physical sensors but also from the middle fusion results in different fusion process level to make full use of the information hidden in the combination of fused information. Real time reasoning method and the integration of qualitative and quantitative information are also proposed in this paper. In addition, predictive simulation display is overlaid on actual live images with high fidelity to compensate for model discrepancies. With the multisensor integration and fusion, the teleoperated arm/hand integrated robotic system can perform some dexterous tasks such as screwing valve, peg in hole, and grasping a cup of water and pushing it to another cup.

articleTitle: Small intelligent robotics suiting for multirobot system, toward the fundamental abilities of object-searching, object-fetching and object-classifying
publicationTitle: IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Systems and Signal Processing, 2003. Proceedings. 2003
abstract: This paper introduce the possibility of the technology of real simple intelligent robotics for multirobot system. The essentials are giving a simple mechanical function and giving a simple algorithm to robot modules as much as possible. This paper deals with fundamental abilities of multirobot system, object-searching, object-fetching and object-classifying. At first, placing robots on a square area bounded with walls, the robots are given an algorithm for simple locomotion with obstacle avoidance. Then, increasing the population size of the robots, their moving pattern is being like one of random-walk manner. Second, adding signal-transmission algorithm for local communication to the robots, in enough size of the population the directions of the transmitted signals make a coordinate vector field. Then, placing another robots given a locomotion algorithm for following the direction of signal reception in the vector field, the robots individually converge to the original signal transmission robot. The third, contacting enough robots around two-dimensional object in close order. The robots relayed a signal transmission in going around the object. Then, the frequencies of the emitting signal in time steps were shown in a specific pattern corresponding to the shape of the object. It is expected to classify the object. Finally, we summarize those emergent behaviors from the viewpoint of small intelligent robotics for multirobot system.

articleTitle: The whole optimization of communication system in view of coding scheme
publicationTitle: IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Systems and Signal Processing, 2003. Proceedings. 2003
abstract: The optimization of communication system can be achieved by optimum coding. Different optimization realization gives rise to different optimum coding-decoding scheme. This paper discusses the feasibility of the realization of the whole optimization of communication system by using joint source channel coding (JSCC) based on the optimum theory of communication system. It also proposes two applications of joint source channel coding scheme, together with the analysis of their experimental results.

articleTitle: A dialogue system based on keyword spotting technology
publicationTitle: IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Systems and Signal Processing, 2003. Proceedings. 2003
abstract: This paper presented a practical dialogue system, Smart-Panda System, which used a keyword spotting (KWS) scheme. In this KWS scheme, decoding and spotting processes were designed to be independent of the vocabulary and any explicit filler model was not needed so that it can be implemented easily for any other desired tasks. A word level confidence measure was incorporated into this system for improving the accuracy of semantic understanding by rejecting uncompetitive keyword hypothesis, which was typically generated by OOV (out-of-vocabulary) speech. Testing results of both the KWS scheme itself with 100 keywords and the Smart-Panda System, which employed this scheme, were reported. The experiments showed that the correct acceptance accuracy of the Smart-Panda System based on the new KWS recognition engine had reached 95.2% at the incorrect acceptance rate of 0.5%.

articleTitle: The reachable workspace analysis of a kind of 4-DOF parallel mechanism based on constraints
publicationTitle: IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Systems and Signal Processing, 2003. Proceedings. 2003
abstract: Aimed at a novel 4-DOF parallel manipulator, the paper brings forward a grid approach which is based on the inverse kinematics result to get its workspace. The paper analyses the kinematics of this kind of parallel manipulator, brings out the formula of the inverse kinematics, then programs, gives several figures of workspace with different parameters and then analyses it finally.

articleTitle: Parameter estimation of thruster motor for underwater robot through weighted least square method
publicationTitle: IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Systems and Signal Processing, 2003. Proceedings. 2003
abstract: This paper presents a weighted least square identification approach to estimate the parameters of an underwater robot thruster motor rated at 0.45ph from off-line dynamic characters. The motor equivalent circuit and mechanical model linear parameters and the nonlinear saturated parameters are estimated. Simulation is studied to validate the accuracy of the identified motor model including the saturation based on the measured dynamic starting performance data.
